math_contract.q_family: m=m0+B a, P=B L L.T B.T with P0=B B.T on its original support; positive log-diagonal full lower Cholesky
math_contract.objective: F(q)=KL(q||fixed p0)+sum_s E_q[-log native Gaussian L_s], each R normalizer once
math_contract.Cholesky_gradient_chain: dF/dL=L-L^(-T)+2 B.T sym(gradient_P) B L; log-diagonal chain multiplies its diagonal by L_ii
math_contract.affine_proof: For exact affine-Gaussian likelihood, F(q)=KL(q||p(z|y))-log p(y). The Gaussian family contains the exact posterior; at the variational optimum q=p(z|y), -F=log p(y).
math_contract.seed_role: One analytic affine surrogate conditioning supplies only an optional starting q. Both q=p0 and seed pay KL to the same original p0 and are compared by the same propagated-moment F; no repeated observation multiplication.
math_contract.sequential_proof: After one completed event, its retained q is the fixed p0 for the next genuinely new event. In the affine exact limit this is ordinary recursive Bayes conditioning; finite optimizer errors can perturb later evidence.
math_contract.native_mixture: Each explicit prior/native combination has a separate optimized Gaussian; log alpha = log prior_mass+log native_mass-F, globally normalized before the existing canonical moment projection.
math_contract.support_measure: Whitening is the covariance square root U sqrt(D), not only the orthonormal support basis. KL is evaluated in the original supported Gaussian chart. Rank zero keeps the exact Dirac prior.

limits: Approximate high-concentration propagated moments mean -F is a moment-ELBO proxy, not guaranteed exact nonlinear evidence or a rigorous lower bound.
Finite iteration/nonstationarity is logged and finite best q is used; gradient_tolerance is not a pipeline stop gate.
The objective is Gaussian reverse-KL variational approximation, not candidate-point MAP/GN/Laplace, and no global optimum is certified.
Canonical within/between projection can change the final law relative to each optimized branch; fit of those stages must be audited separately.

Fixed-goal OT is an explicit cut/coupling convention on the original support, not a uniquely determined Bayesian update. AP A.T=Q proves joint PSD by congruence; conditional Schur equality additionally needs support-invertible A.
Preserving small mixture masses with high/low parts does not guarantee arbitrary-scale exact float64 matrix/quadratic arithmetic.
Current full regression and new180s live validation were not completed by this collector; old-run outcomes are not new-source motion evidence.
Raw image pixels, physical truth and true K are excluded from copied artifacts. Archived payload/index dependencies are references with hashes, not copied bulky raw data.
